name: Dear LMS
author: Sanchit Pandey

sections.description:
Dear LMS is a comprehensive Learning Management System plugin that enables you to create, manage, and deliver online courses directly from your WordPress website.

Key Features

  • Custom Post Types: Courses, Lessons, and Topics with hierarchical relationships
  • Drag-and-Drop Dashboard: Visual course builder with intuitive interface
  • Course Management: Create and organize course content with ease
  • Student Enrollment: Track student progress and manage enrollments
  • Progress Tracking: Monitor student progress through courses
  • User Reports: Comprehensive analytics and reporting
  • Responsive Design: Works beautifully on all devices

Use Cases

  • Online course platforms
  • Educational institutions
  • Corporate training programs
  • Membership sites with educational content
  • Tutorial and documentation sites

Support

For support, please visit https://sanchit.pro or contact the plugin author.

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin includes the following open-source library:

  • Lucide Icons – Icon library (ISC License)

The library is bundled locally and complies with WordPress.org requirements.
For full license information, see assets/vendor/LICENSE.txt
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dear-lms folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to the LMS Dashboard to start creating courses
  4. Configure settings as needed
sections.faq:
How do I create a course?

Navigate to the LMS Dashboard in your WordPress admin panel and use the course builder interface to create and organize your course content.

Can students track their progress?

Yes, the plugin includes built-in progress tracking that allows students to see their completion status for each course.

Is it compatible with my theme?

Dear LMS is designed to work with most WordPress themes. It uses standard WordPress templates and can be customized with CSS.
